profile.lede: I'm Utkarsh, a Computer Science (Cloud Computing) student at Lovely Professional University. I build full-stack and AI systems, keep Linux servers in line, and hold seven cloud certifications across AWS, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud.

projects.title: LPU Research Intelligence & Collaboration Hub
projects.description: A full-stack platform that brings six modules into one system: researcher discovery, project management, publication tracking, patent records, funding opportunities and lab booking. Role-based access control and JWT authentication protect the REST API, with ML-based recommendations, automated testing and cloud deployment.

projects.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Security Platform
projects.description: Research into quantum threats to today's public-key cryptography, built around the NIST standards ML-KEM (Kyber) and ML-DSA (Dilithium). An interactive platform covers quantum security, enterprise migration, HSMs, PKI and TLS integration, with RSA vs PQC demonstrations and quantum-attack simulations.

projects.title: AIRSYS: AI-Powered Airport Intelligence System
projects.description: Predicts crowd density, flight delays and operational risk with Random Forest models served through Flask REST APIs. Includes an intent-based NLP chatbot, live weather and aviation data, and radar analytics for monitoring several airports. Yes, the theme of this site is not a coincidence.

projects.title: OS Thread Mapping & Scheduling Simulator
projects.description: An interactive operating-systems simulator showing thread-mapping models with Round Robin CPU scheduling. It models context switching, kernel thread allocation, starvation and deadlock, and charts execution timelines and scheduling metrics.

logbook.title: Research Intern, CyberPeace Foundation
bullets: Researched cybersecurity topics, emerging technologies and current security trends, completing every assigned research task.
Built and improved web interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python.
Wrote technical documentation and supported project deliverables across the team.

logbook.title: RHCSA Summer Training: Red Hat RH124 & RH134
bullets: Administered Red Hat Enterprise Linux: users and groups, file permissions, storage, networking and system services.
Troubleshot system configuration and ran routine maintenance in hands-on labs.
